notes: 4 tests x 50 = 200, every item in exactly one test (pools exactly 4x each count). Categories are the Sachgebiete of § 7 BewachV and Anlage 2 as split in the DIHK Rahmenplan (1a/1b, 4a/4b); the 6/6/4/7/9/3/4/7/4 split is Tigertest's (no official weights published). Five topic sets 22101-22105 (Öffentliches Recht und Gewerberecht 48, BGB und Datenschutz 44, Strafrecht und Waffen 48, Umgang mit Menschen 28, UVV und Sicherheitstechnik 32) + 4 tests = 9 dashboard steps. passPct 50 = the real written mark (50 percent of the points).
